description:
## [1.32.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.32.0) (2026-10-27)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed streaming broken since Oct 22. MovieBox changed their CloudFront server-side signing and rejected requests signed with the old hardcoded fallback key. The patch now reads the gateway_secret_online key from the installed app manifest at runtime, and stays on Edge-Cache (direct file fallback) when the key is unavailable. Also adds support for MovieBox 4.0.03.1022.03. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.**
